observations: Three photos show a large industrial machine with multiple rollers and a frame structure.
Photo 0: Machine with grey and cream frame, two large teal rollers at the bottom, placed outdoors on dirt ground. A green machine is visible in the background.
Photo 1: Similar machine with cream and orange frame, two beige rollers, and orange knobs. Also outdoors, with plastic-wrapped items in the background.
Photo 2: Machine with blue frame, one beige roller and one dark purple roller. A printed plastic film is visible passing through the rollers. A person’s hand and leg are visible on the right side.
All machines appear to be flexographic printing presses, with multiple rollers and gear systems for feeding and printing material.
No brand or model name is visible on any of the machines in the photos.
The machines are in an outdoor workshop or yard setting, with visible wear and dirt on the ground and parts.
Photo 2 shows printed output, suggesting the machine is operational or has been used recently.

claims.evidence: All three photos show machines with two sets of rollers and printing units, consistent with a double-color flexographic printing setup. Photo 2 shows printed output, confirming printing capability.
